operatingRules: Use one stable origin for browser applications that cache local models; a changed host or port creates independent origin storage.
Declare a larger BFS_PROJECTED_WRITE_GIB value when a preregistered experiment can exceed 20 GiB.
Changing BFS_DISK_RESERVE_GIB is an explicit policy override and must not be inferred from urgency.
A blocked guard is an expected safety result, not an experiment failure.
Preserve tracked evidence and unresolved blind-study material until its retention decision is recorded.
